          "0x6411bed82614b91ef655d82486e0bd3a13d2eb8c"]
EOA = "0x023697eda1dfbe331c2cf791ef2f6089e73e3230"
CODES = block_codes()

                 ("0x2621cc0b3f3c079c1db0e80794aa24976f0b9e3c", "1.0000"),
                 ("0x3041cbd36888becc7bbcbc0045e3b1f144466f5f", "1.0000"),
                 ("0xcf6daab95c476106eca715d48de4b13287ffdeaa", "0.8125")))
PAIR_TOP = "".join(PAIR_LINES.splitlines(True)[:3])

    "ALERT\t%s\t%s\tBELLE honeypot\t0.8667\n" % (a, BELLE) for a in COPIES)


class CountingRpc(object):
    """An rpc that records every call; offline commands must not use it."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def call(self, method, params):
        self.calls.append(method)
        raise AssertionError("an offline subcommand called rpc")


class Sleeper(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def __call__(self, seconds):
        self.calls.append(seconds)
        raise KeyboardInterrupt()


class Boom(dict):
    """A codes map whose __getitem__ raises KeyboardInterrupt."""

    def __getitem__(self, key):
        raise KeyboardInterrupt()


def path_of():
    n[0] += 1
    return os.path.join(T, "db%d.sqlite" % n[0])


def block_db():
    path = path_of()
    store = Store(path)
    for address in sorted(CODES):
        raw = CODES[address]
        body = None if raw == "0x" else bytes.fromhex(raw[2:])
        store.put_address(address,
                          None if body is None else store.put_code(body),
                          BLOCK)
    store.close()
    return path


def belle_db(seed=False, copies=True):
    path = path_of()
    store = Store(path)
    store.put_address(BELLE, store.put_code(load_hex("code_belle.hex")), 1)
    if copies:
        for address in COPIES:
            body = load_hex("code_belle_copy_%s.hex" % address[2:10])
            store.put_address(address, store.put_code(body), 1)
    if seed:
        store.add_seed(BELLE, "BELLE honeypot")
    store.close()
    return path


def progress_of(path):
    store = Store(path)
    try:
        return store.get_progress()
    finally:
        store.close()


def run(name, argv, rpc=None, sleep=None):
    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    rpc = CountingRpc() if rpc is None else rpc
    try:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            code = main(argv, rpc=rpc,
                        sleep=Sleeper() if sleep is None else sleep)
    except BaseException as e:
        bad.append("%s: main raised %s instead of returning an exit code"
                   % (name, type(e).__name__))
        return None, "", ""
    o, e2 = out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()
    if "Traceback" in o + e2:
        bad.append("%s: a traceback was printed" % name)
    if "TESTKEY-0000" in o + e2:
        bad.append("%s: the key was printed" % name)
    return code, o, e2

        (0, PAIR_TOP, ""))


def c4_seed_add_belle():

    chk("C6 recheck without seeds", run("C6a", ["--db", path, "recheck"]),

    chk("C6 recheck on an empty db",
        run("C6b", ["--db", path_of(), "recheck"]), (0, "", ""))

    chk("C6 seed add on an unknown address",
        (code, out, len(err.splitlines())), (2, "", 1))
    store = Store(path)
    store.put_address(EOA, None, 1)
    store.close()
    code, out, _ = run("C6d", ["--db", path, "seed", "add", EOA,
                               "--label", "x"])
    chk("C6 seed add on an EOA", (code, out), (2, ""))
    code, out, _ = run("C6e", ["--db", path, "recheck", "--min", "high"])
    chk("C6 recheck with a bad --min", (code, out), (2, ""))


def c7_other_subcommands(path):
    code, out, err = run("C7a", ["--db", path, "similar", PAIR,
                                 "--min", "0.8"])
    lines = out.splitlines()
    chk("C7 similar", (code, len(lines), lines[-1].split("\t")[-1] if lines
                       else ""), (0, 4, "0.8125"))
    code, out, _ = run("C7b", ["--db", path, "clusters", "top", "--n", "3"])
    lines = out.splitlines()
    chk("C7 clusters top",

    code, out, _ = run("C7c", ["--db", path, "cluster", PAIR])
    chk("C7 cluster", (code, out.split("\t")[0] if out else ""), (0, "L0"))

    chk("C7 seed list", (code, out), (0, "%s\t%s\n" % (PAIR, PAIR_LABEL)))


def c8_backfill_alert_stream():
    path = belle_db(seed=True, copies=False)
    rpc = FakeRpc(
        codes={COPIES[0]: "0x" + load_hex(
            "code_belle_copy_1807090d.hex").hex(), PAIR: CODES[PAIR]},
        receipts=[{"to": COPIES[0]}, {"to": PAIR}])
    chk("C8 cap stop still prints the alert of the incomplete block",
        run("C8", ["--db", path, "backfill", "--from", str(BLOCK), "--to",
                   str(BLOCK), "--max-calls-per-block", "1"], rpc),
        (3, "ALERT\t%s\t%s\tBELLE honeypot\t0.8667\n" % (COPIES[0], BELLE),
         "stopped: cap, spent 1160 credits, progress none\n"))


def c9_listen_interrupt():
    path = belle_db(seed=True, copies=False)
    store = Store(path)

    store.close()
    sleeper = Sleeper()
    chk("C9 Ctrl-C on the first getCode",
        run("C9", ["--db", path, "listen"], FakeRpc(codes=Boom(CODES)),
            sleeper), (0, "", ""))
    chk("C9 progress kept", progress_of(path), BLOCK - 1)
    chk("C9 sleep not reached", sleeper.calls, [])


try:
